newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB sees higher Singapore interest rates.
newsitem.headline: OUB sees higher Singapore interest rates.

text.p: Singapore's Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) said on Friday the city-state's interest rates could rise in 1997, possibly in the second half of the year.

OUB President and Chief Executive Officer Peter Seah told a news conference for the bank's 1996 financial results that it was hard to say how much rates would rise, but said the trend seemed to be upwards.
"The outlook seems to point to a firmer interest rate environment with possibly higher rates in the second half of the year," he said. He gave no reason for his view.
